descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Frosted Purple' Pink-Purple Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Frosted Purple' has a pink purple reticulation to the leaf that makes this tree stand out. The reticulated veins seem to hold well throughout the summer. New growth flushes during the summer are a bright red and often show reticulation as well. Fall color ranges from bright red to red purple. I would expect 'Frosted Purple' to reach 8-10 ft in 10 years. Give 'Frosted Purple' protection from the hot afternoon sun for best growth and color. descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Frosted Purple' 粉紫色网脉斑锦日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 'Frosted Purple' 的叶片带有粉紫色网脉，使这株树格外醒目。 这种网脉叶纹似乎能在整个夏季保持良好表现。 夏季的新梢抽发时呈鲜红色，通常也会显现网脉特征。 秋色从亮红色到红紫色不等。 我预计 'Frosted Purple' 在 10 年内可长至 8-10 英尺。 为获得最佳生长状态和叶色表现，建议为 'Frosted Purple' 避开炎热的午后强光。 'Frosted Purple' 由 Talon Buchholz 于 2003 年从 'Purple Ghost' 的实生苗中偶然发现，外观与其亲本相似，但紫色叶片中的网脉带有更多粉色调。 其色彩甚至比
